description: Compare two email HTML versions, shows score changes, fixed issues, and newly introduced issues per client. Use after making fixes to verify improvements.

after.description: Modified email source, in the same format. Pass this or `afterPath`.

afterPath.description: Absolute path to the modified source file, instead of `after`

before.description: Original email source. Pass this or `beforePath`.

beforePath.description: Absolute path to the original source file, instead of `before`

format.description: Source format: 'html' (default), 'jsx' (React Email), 'mjml', or 'maizzle' (HTML template or Vue single-file component). Anything but 'html' is compiled before analysis and sets the syntax of the fix snippets. A pasted Vue file with no format is compiled as maizzle.

name: diff_emails
title: Diff Emails
